triggering_observation: The preregistered galaxy-scaling run passed for catalog models with eta approximately 0.54, while the surface transition exponent was close to zero. This follow-up was frozen before fitting the missing mass-amplitude-only and mass-transition controls.
question: After every model receives the same mass-dependent amplitude, does a galaxy-dependent transition radius add held-out predictive information?
interpretation: A failure means the successful galaxy-scaling result is an amplitude/mass relation rather than evidence that concentration or density moves the transition point.
